theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_vdb_ball_mass_le_of_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), HasDensity n μ x θ → θ ≠ ∞ → ∃ C r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → μ (closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
